name: Desktop chaos to one clean result
description: Visualize a workflow pain point and its resolution. Builds an editable 12-second vertical ad from your images, logo and copy. AI can suggest options from a website to fill the fields with its copy and images. No generated video.
tagline: A real workflow outcome can resolve an immediately recognizable pain point.

props.title: Desktop chaos to one clean result

props.subtitle: A 5-scene vertical ad, 12 seconds long. You supply images and short lines of copy. The app builds an editable cut, not a generated video.

props.text: Lays out every frame and finishes the cut. Pick one that reads images. Saved for next time.
Optional. Paints backgrounds and decoration for the layout. Saved for next time.

props.label: How do you want to start?

options.title: Fill from a website
options.description: Paste a product page. AI suggests the copy and images.

props.label: Website
props.hint: The agent reads the page with the finishing model and suggests three filled versions, with real images from the site. Pick one, then check each step.

props.text: No site at hand? Try this one.

props.label: Agent
props.placeholder: The agent's reading and image searches appear here.

props.subtitle: Three overlapping windows show the problem. Use screenshots of the tools people switch between.

props.label: Pain detail
props.hint: Shows as more windows pile up.

props.subtitle: All the windows turn into one clean result.

props.label: Turning point
props.hint: Shows as the windows move together.

props.text: One clean screenshot or card of the result.

props.subtitle: The result holds next to the call to action.

props.label: Layout agent
props.placeholder: The agent's layout edits and frame reviews appear here.

props.title: The layout needs a look
props.text: Edit the cut or plan again. You can still approve it.

creativeStrategy.objective: Visualize a workflow pain point and its resolution.
creativeStrategy.direction: The contrast is in visual density: a cluttered start resolves into one dominant result.

shots.title: Several overlapping windows and a short pain statement.

elements.direction: Offset copies enter every 100 ms; restrained 1–2 px shake on accents only.

shots.title: More windows accumulate around the center.

elements.direction: Repeater or duplicates advance by 12–20 px; keep within parent group duration.

shots.title: All window groups move toward one result anchor.

elements.direction: EaseOutExpo collapse over 500 ms; a wipe or clean cut hides the handoff.

shots.title: One clean output dominates with a short benefit.

elements.direction: Result settles; secondary cards stay dim or offscreen.

value.title: Desktop chaos to one clean result
value.objective: Visualize a workflow pain point and its resolution.
value.direction: The contrast is in visual density: a cluttered start resolves into one dominant result.
beats: 0–1.8 s: Several overlapping windows and a short pain statement. Shows Brand color, Window 1, Window 2, Problem.
1.8–4.2 s: More windows accumulate around the center. Shows Brand color, Window 1, Window 2, Window 3, Pain detail.
4.2–6.5 s: All window groups move toward one result anchor. Shows Brand color, Window 1, Window 2, Window 3, Turning point.
6.5–9.5 s: One clean output dominates with a short benefit. Shows Brand color, Result card, Benefit.
9.5–12 s: Product/result plus CTA. Shows Brand color, Result card, Logo, Call to action.

images.label: Window 1
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Several overlapping windows and a short pain statement. | More windows accumulate around the center. | All window groups move toward one result anchor.

images.label: Window 2
images.guidance: A real photo or screenshot that matches the beats that show it. Shown in: Several overlapping windows and a short pain statement. | More windows accumulate around the center. | All window groups move toward one result anchor.

images.label: Window 3

images.label: Result card
images.guidance: A shot of the product alone, ideally on a plain or transparent background, so it reads as a cutout. Shown in: One clean output dominates with a short benefit. | Product/result plus CTA.

images.label: Logo
images.guidance: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Product/result plus CTA.
